renderer: NO_RENDERER — Discoverer [class,id] tokens are parsed into a tree but never rendered back into display form. Phase 4 replaces this.
note: A ratchet, not a target. formula-corpus-agreement.test.ts fails if a change lowers either rate; raise these by hand when a change lifts them, in the same commit that lifts them. Both rates are reported because they answer different questions: distinct is how much of the formula language is covered, weighted is how many real formulas in a real estate would render.
